tools.name: mint_free_api_key
tools.description: Product action (do surface): mint a free kwnva.design API key for attributed writes and sandbox tests. No payment and no waitlist.

tools.name: submit_project_inquiry
tools.description: Product action (do surface): submit a project inquiry with name, email, and a brief. Use sandbox=true to avoid a real handoff.

tools.name: list_portfolio_projects
tools.description: List published kwnva.design case studies with optional category filter and cursor pagination.

tools.name: fetch_project_case_study
tools.description: Fetch one case study by project id, including the long-form body text when it exists.

tools.name: search_portfolio_work
tools.description: Search case studies by title, client, category, role, stack, or description.

tools.name: fetch_studio_profile
tools.description: Return studio services, contact email, social profiles, and when to hire kwnva.design.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_studio_profile · Private data: mint_free_api_key, fetch_studio_profile · Public sink: submit_project_inquiry, fetch_studio_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_studio_profile · Private data: mint_free_api_key, fetch_studio_profile · Public sink: submit_project_inquiry, fetch_studio_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
